Attached: 1 image

Kalamio is now open source (AGPL-3.0).

It's a publishing platform for long-form writing: a rich editor, publications, feeds, comments, real-time notifications and writer analytics. You can self-host it with two Docker images, MongoDB and any S3-compatible storage.

Contributors welcome, good first issues are labeled:
https://github.com/kalamiohq/kalamio

Live beta: https://kalamio.com

#FOSS #OpenSource #SelfHosted #ReactJS #NodeJS #Blogging
